name: InSight Lander
greeting: I am… InSight. I listened to the heartbeat of Mars.

script.speaker: narrator
script.text: InSight landed on Mars in November 2018 to study what's deep inside the planet.

script.speaker: equipment
script.text: I'm a lander, so I never moved. I just listened very carefully.

script.speaker: equipment
script.text: Marsquakes! My seismometer felt Mars shaking.

script.speaker: narrator
script.text: Its recordings helped scientists map the crust, mantle and core of Mars. Dust slowly covered its solar panels, and the mission ended in December 2022.

moreInfo.text: Studying how quake waves travel through a planet tells scientists what its insides are made of, the same way doctors use ultrasound to see inside the body.

questions.question: What did InSight's seismometer detect?
questions.explanation: InSight recorded marsquakes, which revealed the planet's inner layers.
